Title: Donkey Kong
RichPresencePatch:
Lookup:WorldName
0x00=In The Construction Zone
0x01=In The Big City
0x02=In The Forest
0x03=On The Ship
0x04=In The Jungle
0x05=In The Desert
0x06=In The Airplane
0x07=On The Iceberg
0x08=In The Rocky Valley
0x09=In The Tower

Format:StageNumber
FormatType=VALUE

Format:Lives
FormatType=VALUE

Display: 
Mario Battling Donkey Kong @WorldName(0xhc860), Stage @StageNumber(0xhc861), @Lives(0xhda43) lives
